Aspera Connect — install (2 files)
==================================

Downloads
  PC:    AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb   (0.1.0-beta.5)
  Phone: AsperaConnect-Phone.apk     (0.3.10)

  https://github.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/raw/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb
  Phone page: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ramchandragada/asperaconnect@cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/website/phone.html
  https://github.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/raw/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/AsperaConnect-Phone.apk

PC (Linux Mint / Ubuntu / Zorin)
  1. Download AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb
  2. Double-click → Install (or: sudo apt install ./AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb)
  3. Open "Aspera Connect" from the app menu (not Aspera Hub)

Phone (Android)
  Easy: open on phone (or PC → Get phone app QR):
    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ramchandragada/asperaconnect@cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/website/phone.html
  Tap Download → Install (allow Chrome unknown apps once). No USB.
  Hard Play Protect block → company Play Internal testing (docs/PLAY-STORE-INTERNAL.md)
  Version should show v0.3.10

Connect (WhatsApp-style — works across networks)
  Cloud relay is LIVE: wss://aspera-connect-relay.onrender.com
  1. PC: Phone calls → Show QR to pair
  2. Phone: Scan PC QR
     (No camera? PC: Copy pair code → send to phone → Paste pair code)
  3. Done — works even if phone Wi-Fi ≠ PC LAN
  (First connect after idle may take ~1 min while free relay wakes.)

Same-network fallback (no relay): enter phone IP → Connect

Something wrong?  See TROUBLESHOOTING.txt
